scope: Resolve the apparent Super Pack 4 skill-count discrepancy without mutating canonical data. Official Xbox/PlayStation storefront metadata states 5 Additional Skills; the current canonical DLC-label cohort contains 9 records, including one malformed/ID-null Blades of Judgement projection. Character moves for Fused Zamasu and SSGSS Vegito account for the broader in-game skill set, but are not automatically treated as five CaC DLC skills.

sources.finding: Bandai Namco storefront metadata lists 5 Additional Skills, release date 2017-06-27, and the two playable characters.
Bandai Namco PlayStation storefront likewise lists 5 Additional Skills.
Community roster documentation distinguishes 8 non-mentor skills associated with the pack; this is corroboration only, not canonical source of truth.

findings.note: Storefront metadata is treated as authoritative for the marketed Additional Skills count.
Current skills-index DLC label cohort contains 9 names, but one is ID-null and the cohort includes character-specific moves and Sword of Hope; DLC label alone is insufficient to assign every record.
The five previously mapped CaC/DLC skill records remain event mappings. No additional automatic mappings are created from the DLC label.
